name: Name
llmFallbacksUnavailableDograh: LLM fallbacks are unavailable in Dograh mode.
providerConnectionIntro: Connect provider accounts, like OpenAI, Google Gemini, ElevenLabs using API Keys, then reuse it in your model configurations.
connectAccountWithApiKey: Connect an account with its API key. It is saved to Providers, so every model configuration can use it.
editModelConfigurationDescription: Edits apply to future runs of every workflow using this configuration. Existing runs keep their settings.
addModelConfigurationDescription: Save a reusable model setup for workflows and API triggers.
workflowModelConfigurationDescription: Follow a preset configuration or build custom settings for this agent. Changes save to the draft and apply to test calls at once; publish to apply them to live calls.
statusChooseProvider: Choose a provider for each service. The settings save once every service has one.
statusCustomFirstChange: Custom settings for this agent save with your first change. Test calls use them at once; publish to apply them to live calls.
statusCustom: Custom settings for this agent. Test calls use them now; publish to apply them to live calls. Switching back to a preset drops them.
statusNoConfig: No configuration chosen yet. Pick one below, or set an organization default in Models.
statusLegacy: This agent has custom model settings saved before named configurations existed. They stay in use until you choose a configuration or switch to Custom.
statusUnavailable: The selected configuration is unavailable. Choose another one below.
modeRealtimeDescription: One speech-to-speech model listens and replies.
modeDograhDescription: Dograh runs the transcriber, LLM and voice for you.
modeCascadeDescription: Pick your own LLM, STT and TTS providers.
realtimeLlmNote: The realtime model holds the conversation. This text LLM handles variable extraction and other background tasks.
embeddingNote: Use the embedding model that indexed this workflow’s knowledge base. Changing it does not reindex documents.
modelsPageDescription: Create named model configurations using your <link>provider connections</link> in Realtime, Dograh, or BYOK mode.
namedModelConfigurationsDescription: Choose a setup for each workflow or make one your org default. Workflows inherit the default unless overridden.
thenSaveFirstConfiguration: , then save your first named model configuration.
archiveDescription: Archived items cannot be selected for future runs. Items still referenced by active configurations or workflows must be unlinked first.
providersPageDescription: Connect provider accounts, like OpenAI, Google Gemini, ElevenLabs using API Keys, then use them in your <link>named model configurations</link>.
providerConnectionsDescription: Add multiple accounts from any provider, including Dograh.
noProviderConnections: No provider connections yet. Add a provider to get started.
fallbackSlowResponseDescription: Start another LLM if the primary has not produced answer text or a tool call within your time limit.
fallbackRequestErrorDescription: Try another LLM on any error before output, including rate limits, billing errors, connection failures, and empty responses.
llmFallbacksIntro: Keep conversations moving when an LLM is slow or unavailable. Each response starts with your primary LLM; the first answer from an eligible request serves that response.
realtimeFallbackNote: These rules apply to the separate text LLM. They do not switch the realtime audio model.
waitBeforeFallbackHint: The primary keeps running until one request produces output. Allowed: 100–10,000 ms.
fallbackConnectionHint: Use a different connection or model from the primary. Add or manage connections in <link>Providers</link>.
duplicateFallbackTarget: Choose a different connection or model from the primary LLM.
fallbacksFootnote: Fallbacks apply only before answer output or tool execution begins. Backup requests can add cost and send conversation data to their configured provider and region. Changes apply to future runs.
